explore-feed.title: Connect the feedline
explore-feed.prompt: Connect the feedline to the right element.
hints: The driven element is the middle one: a plain half-wave dipole.
explore-feed.success: The middle element is driven. The other two are parasitic: they're not connected to anything.

explore-lengths.title: Set the lengths
explore-lengths.prompt: Make the antenna beam toward the front. Change the rear and front element lengths.
hints: The rear element needs to be longer than the middle one.
The front element needs to be shorter than the middle one.
explore-lengths.success: Longest at the back (reflector), shortest at the front (director): the signal is focused forward.
